seed_ledger.name: Dearborn County Lateral
seed_ledger.reason: No data center tie found. About 12 miles of 20 inch pipe, 265,000 Dth/d, docket CP26-536, Texas Gas Transmission (Boardwalk) to Vistra's Miami Fort plant, in service 2028. Boardwalk's project page names only the plant. Vistra's annual report ties its gas repowering plans to load growth including large data centers in general, and an Ohio legislator's release cites rising demand, but no source names a data center for this lateral. Rerun if a FERC filing or Vistra release names a customer. Searches run: 7. Sources: EIA August 2026 row (power demand only), FERC scoping notice (plant only), Boardwalk project page (plant only), Vistra 10-K and 10-Q (general data center load growth, no site), Ohio House release (demand, no data center), local news (nothing).

evidence.note: Boardwalk page: lateral connects Texas Gas system in Dearborn County to Vistra Miami Fort
Vistra converting Miami Fort to gas, citing rising demand

seed_ledger.name: Line Section 32 Project
seed_ledger.reason: No data center tie found. About 17 miles of 24 inch lateral plus Elkhorn Creek interconnect changes, 190,000 Dth/d, docket CP26-158 filed March 31, 2026, cost about $68 million, to serve a new electric generation facility in Williams County ND (Basin Electric Bison station, about 1,490 MW, 2030). Basin testified that data centers are not behind the plant, though it gets large-load requests. Separate from P3585/P3586. Searches run: 6. Sources: Federal Register notice 2026-07211 (new power plant, no customer named), North Dakota Monitor (not driven by data centers), ND PSC case PU-25-86 (WBI lateral, no data center), Basin Electric page, EIA row (power only).

evidence.note: FERC notice: Line Section 32 Expansion, CP26-158, 17 mi 24 in, 190,000 Dth/d
Basin says plant not driven by data centers
